caption: The drawing consists of a single, large, bold, black line forming a continuous abstract shape in the center of a vertically-oriented, off-white or lightly yellowed rectangular canvas. The line is thick and even throughout, creating two looped forms at the top that curve in opposing directions and then sweep downward into two hook-like curves at the bottom, also facing outward. The loops and curves are interconnected, with the horizontal segment of the line crossing from the left side to the right side at the midpoint, and the entire figure is centrally positioned on the blank background. There are no other colors, markings, or objects present in the composition.
title: Cattle Brand
